purpose: Export market segments with destination countries, quality requirements and certifications needed.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
source_tier: Tier 1 (APEDA; Spices Board; Tea Board; Coffee Board)
methodology: Eight export categories where India holds a material global position. certifications_needed and quality_requirements were prioritised because they are the binding constraints on market entry, more than price.
known_limitations: Export prices and annual volumes fluctuate with global markets, exchange rates and policy (export bans and MEP changes). Price and volume fields are indicative orders of magnitude only, not quotable figures.
